about: Thresholds and word lists for the hidden configuration audit. scripts/hidden_config_audit.py reads this file; change a rule here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes; references/audit-checks.md says what each finding means.

override_high_params.request_type: changes what kind of request every call makes
override_high_params.search_type: turns keyword searches into category browses, or the reverse
override_high_params.br_diagnostics: debug output on every live response: slower and larger, and exposes internals
override_high_params.debug: debug output on every live response: slower and larger, and exposes internals
override_high_params.simple_debug: debug output on every live response: slower and larger, and exposes internals

override_medium_params.sort: forces one sort order on every matching search, so ranking rules and relevance can't act
override_medium_params.fq: filters products out of every matching search, so shoppers can't find them
override_medium_params.efq: filters products out of every matching search, so shoppers can't find them
override_medium_params.rows: changes the page size the storefront asked for
override_medium_params.start: changes which page of results is returned
override_medium_params.fl: changes which product fields come back, which can blank prices or images on the page
override_medium_params.facet.version: changes the shape of the facet response the front end parses
override_medium_params.facet.limit: changes how many facet values come back
override_medium_params.view_id: switches every matching search to another catalog view
override_medium_params.widget_id: switches every matching search to a curated widget

notes.max_audiences_traced: How many in-use audiences (most rules first) step 3 traces to their rules. Used by the steps, not the script; tracing takes six list calls per audience.
notes.max_confirm_calls: At most this many detail calls (get_ranking_rule, get_discovery_media_rule) in step 6 to confirm findings. Used by the steps, not the script.
notes.url_dimensions: Audience dimensions matched against a page URL or referral URL. Values in them are checked for spaces, accents, a leading & and short CONTAINS values.
notes.min_contains_chars: A CONTAINS value on a URL dimension shorter than this matches unrelated URLs ("ZZ" also matches "/buzz"): review.
notes.unused_min_age_days: An audience no rule uses is a clean-up candidate once it's this many days old; younger ones are listed for review (they may be about to be used).
notes.stale_days: A disabled API parameter override untouched for this many days is a clean-up candidate, and an enabled one with no name is flagged for review.
notes.test_name_words: Words in an audience name that suggest a test or one-off; with no rules using it, that audience is cleaned up first.
notes.protected_phrases: Phrases in a name that mean someone asked for it to be kept. Protected items are listed separately, never recommended for deletion.
notes.override_high_params: API parameters that, overridden globally, break or distort every matching request: an enabled override of one is high priority. Values are the reason shown.
notes.override_medium_params: API parameters whose override changes what shoppers see on every matching request and is easy to forget: an enabled override is medium priority. Values are the reason shown.
